sentences.text:
on 6 March, 2025
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice J. Sreenivas Rao
 Writ Petition Nos.7836, 7843 & 7901 of 2017
Common Order:

W.P.Nos.7836, 7901 and 7843 of 2017 are filed questioning the action of respondents in dispossessing the petitioners therein from their houses i.e., house bearing No.51-5- 581 and 51-5-582 constructed over an area of 484 square yards in Sy.No.498; house constructed over a bit of land measuring Ac.0.12 gts., situated in Sy.No.501/A; and earmarking the land admeasuring Ac.0.25 gts., in Sy.No.504/A showing the same as if it is in Sy.No.517 respectively situated at Vangapahad Village, Hasanparthy Mandal, Warangal Urban District along with open land for the purpose of laying the four lane National Highway No.202 (New National Highway No.163), without initiating the land acquisition proceedings, as required under the provisions of the National Highways Act,
1956 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act') and without paying compensation.

2. Heard Sri Nandigam Krishna Rao, learned Senior Counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners,
Sri M.Ramu, learned counsel appearing on behalf of respondent No.2, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing on behalf of respondent Nos.1 and 4 and the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Roads and Buildings appearing on behalf of respondent No.5 in all the writ petitions.
3.

Learned Senior Counsel as well as the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition submitted that the respondent authorities have initiated the proceedings exercising the powers conferred under the provisions of the Act and passed the award.

Pursuant to the said award,
respondent authorities have deposited the amount in favour of the petitioners as per their entitlement.
By virtue of the same, the cause in the writ petitions does not survive.
4. Recording the above said submission, all the writ petitions are closed.
However, the petitioners in these writ petitions are granted liberty to avail the remedies available under law, if any other cause exists.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.

_________________________________ JUSTICE J.SREENIVAS RAO, J Date: 06.03.2025 ES Musku Chinna Hanumanthu vs The Competent Authority Land ... on 6 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65497503/
